## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link relevant spec checklist IDs.

## Validation

List exact commands/results and manual scenarios. Identify checks that remain pending or blocked and why.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope and implementation match the spec, or requirement changes are documented.
- [ ] Relevant tests/checks passed; unavailable checks are recorded without implying success.
- [ ] Affected delivery/acceptance items and the progress log are updated.
- [ ] The diff contains no real clipboard data, vaults, secrets, or build artifacts.
- [ ] Security, accessibility, and migration implications are described where applicable.
